name: Organic Rankine Cycle R245fa (FOSSEE #109)
description: An organic Rankine cycle using R245fa as working fluid. The working fluid is pumped to raise its pressure, then passed to a heater where it converts from liquid to saturated vapour. The high-pressure vapour enters a turbine to generate power. The low-pressure vapour enters a condenser where it converts back to liquid, and the liquid is recycled back to the pump to start the cycle again.
prompt: An organic Rankine cycle with R245fa: pump the working fluid to high pressure, heat it to saturated vapour, expand it through a turbine to produce power, condense it back to liquid, and recycle the liquid to the pump.
notes: FOSSEE DWSIM-Flowsheets #109 Organic Rankine Cycle. Real-sourced, DWSIM-converged ground truth. Working fluid R245fa; single package (Peng-Robinson). 4 material units (Pump, Heater, Expander/Turbine, Cooler/Condenser); closed cycle with recycle stream S-04 (CO-01 -> PM-01). Reference duties: Pump 0.608 kW, Heater 250 kW, Turbine work 21.54 kW, Condenser 229.06 kW (energy balance closes: 250.608 kW in vs 250.6 kW out). Stream molar flow not reported in the FOSSEE source -> null. Belongs to the 3-5 unit complexity bin.
